transaction_manifest.title: Canonical check-in manifest normalizer and first pragmatic native Harness real-work reading

node.title: Canonical check-in manifest normalizer

notes: Yuri authorized pragmatic native-Harness entry into real Raisa development with minimum further generic testing and standing uninterrupted-development authority.
The source result is provider-free, unmounted and reference-only; it grants no operational fact, secret resolution, command or admission authority.
The accepted candidate is Sol recovery work because the native request was rejected before provider I/O.

decisions.summary: Accept the pure exact-byte closed manifest normalizer and frozen typed result at the reviewed source.
The stock headless runner's seven declared tools exceeded the broker's exact three-tool allowlist before any provider call.
Retain native Harness as a monitored secondary worker without default promotion or another generic qualification programme.
Accept the source as Sol recovery after 149 passing focused and surrounding tests and deterministic hygiene checks.

claim_scope: The normalizer consumes caller-supplied canonical bytes only and returns frozen typed data or one deterministic denial.
It reads no filesystem, process environment, configuration, credential, database, route, network or current clock.
The native session made zero provider calls, zero tool calls and zero file changes.
The terminal is attributable from the retained request tool header and pinned source, but the broker reason event was omitted so matched trace_complete is false.
The disposable worker processes, worktree registration and attempt root are absent.
No operational manifest, secret, admission, product runtime, deployment, Pages or protected-ref action occurred.
unresolved_gates: The pure environment evidence-gate evaluator still depends on typed inputs and this normalizer.
No operational manifest instance or external operational fact exists.
Native-Harness useful completion and comparative reliability remain unproved by this pre-provider terminal.
Ordinary-practice activation, product runtime, deployment and protected integration remain closed.

journey.strategic_role: Complete the first real source assignment under pragmatic native-Harness adoption while preserving fail-closed operational boundaries
journey.outcome: The real unmounted normalizer is accepted through Sol recovery and the native transport mismatch has a bounded attributable reading without another interoperability tranche.

current_position.strategic_role: Build the remaining provider-free reference-only environment-evidence model before any evaluator or admission seam

current_position.outcome: One unmounted typed input model can make the later pure evaluator possible without asserting that any external operational fact exists.
unlocks: A closed typed representation for runtime-role, rotation, custody, break-glass and freshness readings.

current_position.orientation_statement: Continue development, reuse only already accepted compatible Harness machinery, and decline the native lane rather than reopen generic interoperability testing.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Preplanning Git bindings are machine-resolved full objects and the undispatched lane is planned.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first receipt used manual Git bindings and the premature selected disposition.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The preflight rejected the receipt before dispatch.

correction.action: Use the machine snapshot and planned disposition.
correction.prevention_control: Preplanning receipts bind resolved 40-character objects and pre-dispatch lane states.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected preplanning binding and disposition error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Windows searches use explicit paths or directory roots.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Ripgrep received a Windows-invalid wildcard dependency path.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Ripgrep returned an invalid-target error without mutation.

correction.action: Use explicit dependency paths.
correction.prevention_control: No wildcard is supplied as a Windows ripgrep path argument.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected Windows wildcard search.

correction.prevention_control: Repository package scripts use module invocation.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one corrected package invocation error.
